Your adventure begins here.
en
fi
Adventure = Exciting and special experience
Are you dreaming of an adventure? Conquer pristine snow-covered slopes, admire the dance of the Northern Lights under the open sky. Immerse yourself in the colorful splendor of autumn nature or the peace of the famous blue hour on winter days. This and much more awaits the adventurer of Lapland.
Seize the moment and let Lapland surprise you!
Experientialism
True adventure doesn't require great deeds, rather just letting your heart stop for the moment.
Adventure is conquering the untouched slopes, a joyful jump from the sauna into a snowdrift, or an unforgettable meal on a mountain hike.
Equally, it's the magical silence of Lapland under the Northern Lights, a sleigh ride or learning a new skill - all equally valuable.
The enchantment of Pyhäntunturi is created by the peace, pure nature and the area's diverse sports and outdoor activities.
Pyhä Igloos is an exciting accommodation destination for adventure seekers at the foot of Pyhätunturi.
Pyhä Igloos is located in the immediate vicinity of Pyhätunturi and Pyhä-Luosto National Parks. You can stay comfortably alone or with a group of 2-4 people in our spacious, glass-roofed rooms decorated with Finnish design. Each room has its own entrance from the outside. In the courtyard you can use the sauna & jacuzzi, fireplace room and an atmospheric barbecue hut. Services are nearby and the culinary experiences of your trip will be organized by our partner Outdoor Artisans according to your wishes.
Our well-equipped 32 m² glass-roofed rooms offer comfortable space for 2-4 people and front-row seats to the northern lights.
Mystical Lapland
The mysticism of Lapland is a combination of the beauty of pure nature, magic of the northern lights, and mythical stories about the spirits of nature. In addition to the feeling of limitlessness, the concept of time is blurred, since the days do not follow the usual rules in Lapland. In summer, the sun never sets, and in the darkness of winter, the days are bathed in a gentle blue glow as nature offers a break from the hustle and bustle.
The magnificent Pyhätunturi is one of the oldest highlands in Finland, and it has a special significance in the Sámi culture.

Our glass-roofed Igloos
en
fi
Good nights sleep amidst silence
The spacious, fully equipped rooms provide perfect base for your wilderness adventure. The panoramic view of the Lapland sky from the glass-roofed room is like a window into your dreams. In our Northern Light rooms you can explore Finnish design, which is known worldwide for its practicality, beauty and strong connection to nature.
The spirit of Igloos is created from the moments our guests experience here.
We guarantee that when you leave, a part of Pyhätunturi always goes with you.
The rooms are equipped with
Our comprehensively equipped rooms are ecological with low-energy usage.
The spacious 32 m² rooms comfortably accommodate 2–4 people.
Each room has its own entrance from the outside.
A high-quality motorized double bed is placed under the glass roof that opens up to views of the northern sky.
An extra bed is a sofa bed that can be conveniently extended and converted into two separate beds.
The windows are possible to cover with blackout curtains, which is especially nice in the summertime during the nightless nights of Lapland.
The rooms have spacious shower with toilet, and separate drying cabinet for clothes.
The well-equipped kitchenette includes a refrigerator, stove, dishes and cutlery, an electric kettle, a coffee maker, microwave and dishwasher.
Airconditioning and electric fireplace provide warmth and ambiance.
The washing machine at reception is free of use for our guests.
Pyhä Igloos is ecological accommodation on environmental terms.
When staying with us, you can easily manage without a car. You can access the hiking trails, ski trails and ski resort of Pyhä-Luosto directly from your accommodation. The nearest grocery store, restaurants and the Naava Nature Center are located about 600 meters away.
We are a Green Key certified host
We maintain sustainable tourism. As a Green Key certified accommodation, our daily environmental work includes resource efficiency in water and energy consumption, waste reduction and recycling as well as offering local, vegetarian and organic products, using eco-labelled detergents, cleaning agents and paper, also enabling customers to travel ecologically and to be able to enjoy nature tourism.
Recycling is an essential part of our service concept
We choose ecological products and materials, avoiding unnecessary packaging materials and always recycle bio-waste in our own composter. Recycling bins can be found under the sink in every room.
We avoid unnecessary laundry
We use environmentally friendly and eco-labeled laundry detergents and avoid unnecessary laundry. Bed linen and towels are changed after the fourth night. If you would like to have them changed more often, please contact reception.
Parking and electric car charging facilities
There are free parking spaces in the courtyard, as well as free 11 kWh charging point for charging hybrid and electric cars.
A healthy log building ensures good indoor air quality in the apartments.
Pyhä Igloos are built from logs of Lapland, which are breathable, durable and natural. The building has a small carbon footprint, as wood absorbs carbon dioxide and the material can be recycled or reused. Igloos indoor air is highly fresh and very healthy.
Saving Finland’s freshly clean and drinkable tap water is very important to us
Finnish tap water is high quality, clean, safe and tastes amazing straight from the tap. We want to save our precious water and we have made it easy for you too: the rooms have water-saving taps and toilets. Please select the eco program in the dishwasher in the rooms and follow the detergent dosage instructions, thank you.
The basis of sustainable operations is the use of renewable energy
We use renewable energy sources on our property, such as geothermal energy and solar energy. Airconditioning heats the rooms in the winter and cool in the summer which helps reducing the energy overconsumption of the accommodation service. The electricity we use is ecological and green electricity.

WELCOME TO PYHÄ IGLOOS!
en
fi
INFO AND ARRIVAL
Pyhä-Luosto is located in the province of Lapland, in Finland about 130 kilometers north of Rovaniemi, Santa Claus' hometown.
You are warmly welcome to stay in our cozy glass-roofed rooms and with these instructions you will find us easily!
Fly to Rovaniemi or Kittilä - The drive from Rovaniemi to Pyhätunturi takes about 90 minutes. Bus connections from Rovaniemi airport and train station to Pyhätunturi – Routing 4 times a day in the winter and twice a day in the summertime.
Kittilä is located 155 km from Pyhätunturi and the journey takes about 2 hours by car. We recommend renting a car at Kittilä Airport. The bus connections from Kittilä Airport goes via Rovaniemi and are limitless.
Our reception is open daily from 10 am to 12 pm and from 4 pm to 7 pm. If you wish to check-in after reception opening hours, you will receive an email with your room number and the door code valid for the day. If you are staying with us for more than one night, the keys and area maps can be found in your room. Instructions for the room mechanics can be found in the QR codes.
P.S. Did you remember to fill out the electronic accommodation card? And if you share posts on social media, tag @pyhaigloos so we can spread the word!
WELCOME TO PYHÄ IGLOOS!
BY PLANE
Both Rovaniemi and Kittilä have direct flights during the winter season, from over 20 European cities.
Pyhätunturi is located about a 90-minute drive from Rovaniemi Airport. From Rovaniemi, the journey to Pyhätunturi can be continued by taxi, bus or car.
An easy and affordable way to get to Pyhätunturi from Rovaniemi Airport is to take the SkiBus. The bus leaves from the main entrance of Rovaniemi Airport on the right. The final stop of the SkiBus is in front of Ski-Inn Pyhätunturi. You can also arrange a return ride with the driver when you arrive.
From: Rovaniemi airport (Rovaniemi)
To: Pyhätunturin Liikekeskus, Pyhätunturi (Pelkosenniemi). From Liikekeskus to Pyhä Igloos 200 metres.
Skibus tickets and schedules
Those traveling to Pyhätunturi via Kittilä can request a quote from local taxi services.

By train or car train
The closest train stations to Pyhätunturi are located in Kemijärvi and Rovaniemi. Night trains from Helsinki to Rovaniemi and Kemijärvi depart every day in the evening, offering a pleasant way to travel to Lapland in your own cabin.
VR Trains Helsinki-Kemijärvi and Helsinki-Rovaniemi routes also serve passengers travelling with car. You can redeem tickets on VR's website and/or in the free VR Matkalla app.
The distance from Kemijärvi to Pyhätunturi is approximately 50 kilometers. After the trains arrival to Kemijärvi, a Ski bus service to Pyhätunturi departures from the station. Bus tickets can be purchased from www.matkahuolto.fi or directly from the bus. The journey takes approx. 40–50 minutes, depending on the road conditions and route. The road from Kemijärvi to Pyhätunturi is well marked, and the roads are usually kept in good condition every season.
The distance from Rovaniemi railway station to Pyhätunturi is 150 km. The bus from Rovaniemi railway station to Pyhätunturi and back runs four times a day.
From: Rovaniemi railway station (Rovaniemi)
To: Pyhatunturi (Pelkosenniemi)
Skibus tickets and schedules
Alternatively, you can rent a car from the railway station or take a taxi. The journey takes about 1.5 hours by car and the roads are in good condition.
Taxis and chartered transport
Distances are long in the north of Finland, and taxis are a flexible and fast option for getting from one place to another. Taxis are easily available at both the Rovaniemi train station and the airport. Taxi ranks can be found right in front of the terminal and train station.
There is no taxi rank on duty in Pyhätunturi, but you can book a ride in advance to ensure a smooth transfer. It is worth agreeing on the price of the transport in advance.
By rental car
Renting a car from Rovaniemi airport or train station allows you to move freely. The selection of vehicles with additional services is diverse and the rental times are flexible. Pick-up and return is possible at most rental companies according to the customer's schedule, even outside opening hours. It is advisable to book a car well in advance to ensure the vehicle and additional services you want.
There are multiple parking spaces and one charging point for electric cars provided in Pyhä Igloos.
